title: mode
tooltip: Allows to display historical Structure or only the recent ones

title: style
tooltip: Indicator color theme

title: Color Candles
tooltip:
Paint whole candles (body, border and wick) with the internal structure trend: the Bullish Structure color while it is bullish, the Bearish Structure color while it is bearish (light/dark gray in Monochrome style). Filled = the candle closed with the trend, hollow = a pullback candle.

The indicator has to sit in front of the chart candles (indicator ⋯ menu → Visual Order → Bring to Front). Sent behind them, only the candle bodies are colored

title: Hide Zones Farther Than (× Recent Range)
tooltip:
Recent range = highest high to lowest low of the last 120 chart bars (about one screen).

Order blocks, fair value gaps, previous day/week/month levels, key level zones and demand/supply lines lying more than this share of the recent range above its high or below its low are not drawn (they are still tracked and reappear when price gets closer), so far-away objects never squash the candles.

The range is measured on the chart itself, so one value fits every timeframe and follows the current volatility.

0.2 is a display padding choice, not a predicted price boundary. Zones reappear when their price range intersects the recent range plus padding. Market price can travel beyond this range.

0 = draw everything

title: Show Internal Structure
tooltip: Display internal market structure

title: Internal Length
tooltip: Number of bars used to confirm internal (minor) swing points. The effective internal length is capped below Swing Length so internal structure stays the smaller structure

title: Confluence Filter
tooltip:
Filter non significant internal structure breakouts

A bullish break only counts when the breakout candle closes in the upper half of its range (a bearish break: lower half), so rejection-wick fakeouts are ignored. A later candle that closes beyond the level with a valid close still confirms the break

title: Show Swing Structure
tooltip: Display swing market Structure

title: Show Swings Points
tooltip: Display swing point as labels on the chart

title: Show Strong/Weak High/Low
tooltip: Highlight most recent strong and weak high/low points on the chart

title: Internal Order Blocks
tooltip:
Display internal order blocks on the chart

Number of internal order blocks to display: the ones nearest to price

title: Swing Order Blocks
tooltip:
Display swing order blocks on the chart

Number of swing order blocks to display: the ones nearest to price

title: Order Block Filter
tooltip:
Method used to filter out volatile order blocks 

It is recommended to use the cumulative mean range method when a low amount of data is available

title: Order Block Candle
tooltip:
Opposite Candle (ICT): bullish OB = last down-close candle before the bullish displacement that broke structure, bearish OB = last up-close candle before the bearish displacement. If the leg has no such candle, or that candle is a volatile outlier (Order Block Filter) or was closed through before the break, no OB is drawn

Extreme Candle (LuxAlgo): the candle with the lowest low / highest high of the leg, whatever its color

title: Displacement Body (× ATR)
tooltip: ICT mode. A displacement candle needs a body of at least this many ATR(14) in the direction of the break

title: Equal High/Low
tooltip: Display equal highs and equal lows on the chart

title: Bars Confirmation
tooltip: Number of bars used to confirm equal highs and equal lows

title: Threshold
tooltip:
Sensitivity threshold in a range (0, 1) used for the detection of equal highs & lows

Lower values will return fewer but more pertinent results

title: Fair Value Gaps
tooltip: Display fair values gaps on the chart

title: Auto Threshold
tooltip: Filter out non significant fair value gaps

title: Timeframe
tooltip: Fair value gaps timeframe. Must be the chart timeframe or higher; a lower timeframe falls back to the chart timeframe (a label on the chart says so)

title: Extend FVG
tooltip: Determine how many bars to extend the Fair Value Gap boxes past the current bar

title: Extend Until Filled
tooltip: Keep unfilled gaps extended to the current bar (plus the Extend FVG bars). A gap is deleted once price fills it completely

title: Max Active FVGs (per side)
tooltip: Oldest unfilled gaps beyond this count are removed

title: Premium/Discount Zones
tooltip: Display premium, discount, and equilibrium zones on chart

title: Threshold Mode
tooltip:
--- Threshold Mode ---

ATR: every distance below is a multiple of ATR(14), so one setting fits every timeframe and adapts to gold volatility.

Percent: the legacy fixed % inputs further down.

title: Min departure (× ATR)
tooltip: ATR mode. A zone is added once the bullish/bearish run away from the base candle covers this many ATRs (open to close).

title: Max zone height (× ATR)
tooltip: ATR mode. Zones taller than this are trimmed toward the base candle.

title: Show lines within (× ATR)
tooltip: ATR mode. Lines are shown for active zones within this distance of the close.

title: Min % change (Percent mode)
tooltip:
--- Min % change ---

A zone is added if one candle or a run of bullish/bearish candles meets this minimum % change.

Signed change is measured from the first departure candle open to the current close, divided by that first open. Demand requires a rise; supply requires a fall. Adjust the % for the pair and the timeframe.
e.g. Crypto 15m 0.8% 1m 0.5%, Forex 15m 0.4%

title: Max % zone height (Percent mode)
tooltip:
--- Max % zone height ---

The zone height is decided by the size of the candle before a significant drop or rally.

Setting a higher max % will keep the height closer to candle height.
Setting a lower max % makes the boxes look a bit tidier.

title: Max line
tooltip:
--- % Line  --- 
Display lines of active zones when the close is within this % of the line. Max is 5%.

 --- Max Line  --- 
The maximum number of lines to display for each zone type.

title: Max number of zones
tooltip:
--- Max number of zones ---

The maximum number of zones for each zone type.
Up to 150 boxes per side, reserving drawing capacity for the independent OB, FVG and pivot systems. Oldest tested/invalidated zones leave first.

title: Timezone offset (H)
tooltip:
--- Timezone offset (H)  --- 
If your chart timezone is not set set to UTC, set the offset in hours.
Range: -12 to +14.

Time information is displayed when hovering over zone labels.

title: Background
tooltip: Filled/solid = Fresh. A proximal wick touch makes the zone Tested (transparent/dotted). A confirmed close below its distal bottom makes demand Invalidated (transparent/dashed gray).

title: Background
tooltip: Filled/solid = Fresh. A proximal wick touch makes the zone Tested (transparent/dotted). A confirmed close above its distal top makes supply Invalidated (transparent/dashed gray).

title: Supply
tooltip:
--- Demand & Supply Alerts ---

Two types of alerts are sent:
1. Hit: The price hits an active zone.
2. Near: The price approaches the active zone.

 --- Supply Example ---
1. When the price is below the supply zone and the high hits the zone, an alert is sent.
2. When the price is below the supply zone and the high is within the Near %, an alert is sent.

title: Mins no repeat
tooltip:
--- Mins No Repeat ---

Wait x mins before sending a similar alert type for the same zone.

Setting this to 0 will turn this feature off.
Max = 120mins.

title: Near %
tooltip:
--- Near % ---
Percent mode. The alert is sent when the high or low is within this % of the zone. Max is 5%.

title: Near (× ATR)
tooltip: ATR mode. The near alert is sent when the high or low is within this many ATRs of the zone.

title: Look Left
tooltip: Look left for swing high/low in x number of bars to form pivot. The higher the number, the higher the script looks to the left for the highest/lowest point before drawing pivot

title: Look Right
tooltip: Look right for swing high/low in x number of bars to form pivot. The higher the number, the higher the script looks to the right for the highest/lowest point before drawing pivot

title: Number of Pivots
tooltip: This sets the array size, or the number of pivots to track at a time (x highs, and x number of lows)

title: ATR Length
tooltip: Number of bars to average. ATR is used to standardize zone width between assets and timeframes

title: Zone Width (ATR)
tooltip: ATR multiplier to set zone width. Default is half of one ATR from box bottom to box top

title: Max Zone Percent
tooltip: Max zone size as a percent of price. Some assets can be too volatile at low prices creating an unreasonably sized zone

title: Max Boxes for Patterns
tooltip: Number of boxes for candlestick patterns to track historically. Note: the higher the number the less pivot zones will be tracked when looking back in time due to the limitation on the number of box elements allowed at once

title: Offset For Labels
tooltip: Number of bars to offset labels for price levels

title: Source For Pivots
tooltip: Source input for pivots. Default uses actual candle bodies. HA uses averaged Heikin-Ashi bodies; High/Low uses actual candle wicks. These are pivot Support/Resistance zones, separate from SMC order blocks and Demand/Supply

title: Align Zones
tooltip: Aligns recurring zones who's edges overlap an existing zone creating a zone that ages in time and intensifies visually

title: Extend Right
tooltip: Extends current zones right

title: Show Level Labels
tooltip: Show labels for price levels extended off Key Levels

title: Detect Pivot Highs
tooltip: Disabling will prevent highs from being tracked

title: Detect Pivot Lows
tooltip: Disabling will prevent lows from being tracked

title: Detect Breakout
tooltip: Show points that price action breaks above all pivots. An arrow from below is displayed

title: Detect Breakdown
tooltip: Show points that price action breaks below all pivots. An arrow from above is displayed

title: Detect Resistance Break
tooltip: Show points that price action breaks above resistance. An arrow from below is displayed

title: Detect Support Break
tooltip: Show points that price action breaks below support. An arrow from above is displayed

title: Detect False Breakdown
tooltip: Show points that price action initially breaks below support before reversing. False moves can lead to fast moves in the opposite direction (bear trap). A large arrow from below is displayed

title: Detect False Breakup
tooltip: Show points that price action initially breaks above resistance before reversing. False moves can lead to fast moves in the opposite direction (bull trap). A large arrow from above is displayed

title: Detect Moves Off Support
tooltip: Show up candles that are detected within a support zone. Can show points support is being respected. A triangle from below is displayed

title: Detect Moves Off Resistance
tooltip: Show down candles that are detected within a resistance zone. Can show points resistance is being respected. A triangle from above is displayed

title: Detect TSI Curl
tooltip: Show Bjorgum TSI 'curl' when candles are detected in the range of a key zone. Can show momentum shift at Key Levels. (Correlates to Bjorgum TSI indicator)

title: Wait For Confirmed Bar
tooltip: Wait for candles end before detecting patterns. False will show potential patterns forming before they are confirmed.

title: Show Label
tooltip: Show a label for detected candle patterns

title: Show Boxes Around Patterns
tooltip: Show a box around detected candle patterns

title: Detect Doji
tooltip: Detect Doji candle patterns

title: Detect Engulfing
tooltip: Detect Engulfing patterns

title: Detect Hammers and Stars
tooltip: Detect Hammers and Shooting Star patterns

title: Detect Dragons and Graves
tooltip: Detect Dragonfly Doji and Gravestone Doji patterns

title: Detect Tweezers
tooltip: Detect Tweezer Top and Tweezer Bottom patterns

title: Detect Spinning Top
tooltip: Detect Spinning Top patterns

title: Detect Piercing and Clouds
tooltip: Detect Piercing and Dark Cloud Cover patterns

title: Detect Harami
tooltip: Detect Harami candle patterns

title: Detect Long Shadows
tooltip: Detect Long Upper Shadow and Long Lower Shadow patterns

title: Engulfing Must Engulf Wick
tooltip: Determines if engulfing candles must engulf the wick or just the body of the preceding candle

title: H&S Must Match Color
tooltip: Determines if hammers must be up candles and shooting stars must be down candles

title: Tweezer Close Over Half
tooltip: Determines if Tweezer patterns must close beyond the half way point of the preceding candle

title: Max Candle Size (× ATR)
tooltip: Maximum size of setup candles (as a multiplier of the current ATR)

title: [EC] Max Reject Wick Size
tooltip: The maximum wick size as a percentage of body size allowable for a rejection wick on the resolution candle of the pattern. 0 disables the filter

title: [HS] H&S Ratio (%)
tooltip: The relationship of body to candle size for hammers and stars. (ie. body is 33% of total candle size).

title: [HS] H&S Opposing Shadow (%)
tooltip: The maximum allowable opposing wick size as a percent of body size (ex. top wick for a hammer pattern etc.)

title: [HS] H&S Min Size (× ATR)
tooltip: The minimum size of hammers, stars, or long shadows as a multiplier of ATR. (To filter out tiny setups)

title: [DJ] Doji Size (%)
tooltip: The relationship of body to candle size (ie. body is 5% of total candle size).

title: [DJ] Max Doji Wick Size
tooltip: Maximum wick size comparative to the opposite wick. (eg. 2 = bottom wick must be less than or equal to 2x the top wick).

title: [LS] Long Shadow (%)
tooltip: A relationship of the upper wick to the overall candle size expressed as a percent.

title: Lookback For Breaks
tooltip: Maximum confirmed bars from a close beyond one pivot zone to a close reclaiming its opposite edge. Break and reclaim must refer to the same unchanged zone; wick-only sweeps are not included

title: swing High/Low
tooltip: Swing detection is used to filter signals on breakout type signals. A higher number will mean more significant points, but less of them

title: Significant High/Low
tooltip: Filter to ensure a setup is a significant swing point. Look back this far (maximum 250 bars)

title: Consider Bar From High/Low
tooltip: Candle pattern high/low rank from the significant extreme. 0 requires the highest/lowest; 1 accepts the next rank. Values above Significant High/Low are clamped to that length

title: Select a Speed
tooltip: TSI speed control presets. Both speeds correlate to the Bjorgum TSI indicator

title: Directions Dashboard
tooltip: Show secondary directional context. To reorder rows, swap BOTH position numbers. On/Off controls row visibility; all-nine alerts still require all nine calculations.

title: D Value - Stochastic RSI
tooltip: Used by K vs D direction mode. K vs 50 uses K only.

title: Momentum Length
tooltip: Close compared with its value this many bars ago. Positive = bullish, negative = bearish; a directional context reading, not an entry signal.

title: ADX Trend Threshold
tooltip: DMI shows wait while ADX is below this level. 0 = always show the DI+/DI- direction. ADX measures trend strength, not direction.

title: Turn Money Flow Index Label On/Off
Alternate Buy/Sell (Fixed mode)
tooltip: Fixed mode only. Only allow a SELL after a BUY (and vice versa), so a strong trend does not print repeated counter-trend signals
